proposition: Ibn Turka ties the seventh level to jafr: the Family of the Seal (ʿAlī and his sons) left a transcript, called jafr, which shows how to derive the full meaning of the Seal's speech, and he reads the wording of Q 54:1 as a demonstration of that path.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
